value:
TWO DEFECTS IN `probe.py --raw`, THE ONE FLAG THE PINNED/PROMOTION BACKLOG RUNS ON, both hit in run 50 on game/movie/movieplayer and both traced to a line, not inferred. Reported by the MP lane; tools/gdl is owned by the tool lane, so nothing was fixed here.

DEFECT 1 -- THE RAW WORD COUNT IS NEVER PRINTED FOR AN ADDRESS-SUFFIXED FUNCTION NAME, AND THE FALLBACK MESSAGE ASSERTS A FALSE CAUSE. probe.py:5013 computes `fn_stripped = re.sub(r"_80[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$", "", fn)` to accept either spelling of a name, and every other use is a tolerant `in (fn, fn_stripped)` alternative. The ONE exception is probe.py:5029, `measured = raw_word_residual(unit, fn_stripped)`, which passes the stripped name ALONE. For `fn_800D967C` the regex matches the whole suffix and the argument becomes the literal string `fn`, so `wf_word_diff.word_diff` raises `KeyError: "symbol 'fn' not found"` from webfrank._find_symbol, `raw_word_residual`'s blanket `except Exception` returns None, and the loop prints `[RAW WORDS: not measurable -- the two streams are count-asymmetric, or the raw body could not be read. A count-asymmetric function is outside every postprocessor class by construction, so there is no word residual to arbitrate on.]` -- while the same function is 13/13 and `composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D967C` prints `DIFFERING WORDS = 2 ... DECODE: REGFIELD-ONLY 2`. The message names the one conclusion that would take the function OUT of every postprocessor class, on a function that is squarely IN one. REPRODUCE: `python tools/gdl/probe.py game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D967C --raw` (no count, false message) against `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D967C` (2). In-process both spellings work -- `probe.raw_word_residual('game/movie/movieplayer', 'fn_800D967C')` returns `(2, 13, 0, True, {'REGFIELD-ONLY': 2, ...})` -- so the defect is exactly the stripped argument. POPULATION, measured at 443785f05 over config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt: 307 of 307 `fn_*` function names match the regex and become the string `fn`; 4406 further non-`fn_` names end in an address suffix too (`attract_screen_name_80014F34`, and among functions `DiffRate_8002951C`, `adjust_radius_8002B2D4`, `cam_orient_to_80029E8C`, `FindStringMessageListSub_8001FC4C`). Of the 152 WebFrank-pinned functions -- the backlog `--raw` exists to serve -- 26 (17%) can never get a raw word count from the loop. The obvious fix is to pass `fn` and let raw_word_residual try both spellings, exactly as score_function and object_digest already do.

DEFECT 2 -- ON A PINNED TU, `--raw` PLUS A FILE-SCOPE EDIT REPORTS EVERY SIBLING AS DESTROYED. Measured: a probe of fn_800D967C carrying a new class declaration printed `TU-SCOPE REGRESSED  51 BYTE-EXACT sibling(s) lost` and named all 51 (`PlayVQMovie  function vanished from object`, `__dt__5CodecFv  function vanished from object`, ...), while `fndiff.raw_signature` on the object probe had just built listed all 52 functions and the file was 31272 bytes. 51 = 52 minus the probed function, which tu_sibling_regressions filters out, so the CURRENT snapshot was EMPTY. MECHANISM: probe's TU cross-check calls `defake_gate.measure_unit`, which builds its snapshot from `run_fndiff(unit, '--classify')` -- defake_gate.py:1543, a subprocess of `fndiff.py <unit> --classify` with NO `--raw`, i.e. over the POSTPROCESSED object. Under `--raw` the postprocessed object is exactly what cannot be built: the edit has drifted the pinned function's body hash and the WEBFRANK edge aborts. run_fndiff only raises when the output contains `missing:`, so a WEBFRANK abort returns an empty stdout, `snapshot('')` is `{}`, and `compare(baseline, {})` emits `function vanished from object` for every baseline entry. The gate is fail-closed by design, so it also refuses the bank -- correct behaviour reached through a fabricated finding. This fires on the ordinary promotion loop: `--raw` exists BECAUSE a stale pin blocks the postprocessed build, and the cross-check the same invocation runs depends on that build succeeding. The cross-check should read the same raw object `--raw` scored, or report TU-SCOPE UNGATED rather than a named list of destroyed siblings.
